quotations.old_english: Is áwriten ðætte Dauid suíðlíce hreówsade ðæt hé him (Saul) suá ungeriesenlíce geðénigan (-ðénian, v. l.) sceolde

source_text: ge-þegnian. Add :-- Is áwriten ðætte Dauid suíðlíce hreówsade ðæt hé him (Saul) suá ungeriesenlíce geðénigan (-ðénian, v. l.) sceolde, Past. 199, 18.
